residual_risks: Because of the router order in client/src/App.tsx, `/our-vision` matches before the session-gated routes, so the essay never resolves identity. The 'Return to Nami' link (`href="/"`) and the header home link both do a full page load to `/`, which goes back through the existing root session handling. No redirect input is added. Clicking 'Our Vision' on `/login` also does a full navigation. Any in-progress Google sign-in state in that tab is lost, but the user can retry and no app data is affected.

Removing `maximum-scale=1` from the viewport tag lets users zoom on mobile. The Explore composer textarea uses `text-[1.0625rem]` (17px), so iOS should not auto-zoom when it gets focus. Any input elsewhere with a font size under 16px would now auto-zoom on iOS. I did not check every input.
testing_gaps: No test renders OurVision or PublicHeader with the `.dark` class. Dark-theme readability depends on the `.dark .bg-white` and `.dark .text-stone-700` overrides in client/src/index.css working together with `prose-invert` on the article.
